scientific_role: independent real-data external validity test and negative control; never a post-hoc replacement for unfavorable V2 outcomes

reason_for_v3.v2_limitation: V2 used the decision index as relative time inside a randomly sampled historical window, so the 1000 coordinates did not define a reusable state-feedback policy.
reason_for_v3.v3_correction: V3 defines a 1000-point response profile from observable forecast stress to target state of charge and fixes the physical simulation horizon separately at 168 hours.

primary_claim_gates.source_learning_supported: source_atlas improves on both generic_dct_maximin and natural_constant_grid at the geographic-region level without more false certificates and is not worse than target_only_dct_space_scbo on certified objective.
primary_claim_gates.structural_compression_only: structured controls improve on raw_sobol but source_atlas does not improve on both source-free structured controls.
primary_claim_gates.external_failure: source_atlas and source-free structured controls fail to produce reliable certified policies; retain V3 as a negative external-validity result and narrow the claim.
primary_claim_gates.functional_control_wins: source scoring is not established beyond target-only low-frequency functional optimization; narrow the contribution to ordered-profile compression.
